title: Proving ground: local end-to-end run on 2-3 aptamers
description: Run autoreporting (docker autorep:20260608.1, main.py with the autoreporting_decode.json settings, no gwascatalog) on one strong cis aptamer, one modest cis and one trans-only aptamer, then the step-2 script extracted from the WDL. Checks: dotted phenocode survives, missing af -> aaf NA, chrX sets get cs_min_r2, the mlog10p~20000 cis lead does not break the dynamic r2 threshold, runtime per aptamer is acceptable for 4907 shards. This is the epic's kill criterion.
notes:
Proving ground, first aptamer seq.4876.32 (F9, X-linked): local autoreporting (docker autorep:20260608.1, local R13 annotation subset, no functional annotation, no GWAS catalog) took 39 min, 38 of them in LD grouping of 77 candidate leads (7 remain after --finngen-variants-only). Step 2 on the report: 7 pseudo CS / 83 variants; trait F9, trait_original seq.4876.32, data_type pQTL, cell_type plasma, aaf NA; three cis sets at chrX:139.46-139.56 Mb (F9 is at chrX:139.5 Mb) with cs_min_r2 0.74/0.81/1.0 -- the chrX LD fix verified on real data; trans sets at GCKR (chr2:27.5 Mb) and chr7/chr13.
Second aptamer seq.7085.81 hung 10 h: after the first 20-minute token refresh the container's token was invalid (refresh calls gcloud inside the container) and TabixLD retries a failing GCS read forever ('Failed to read BGZF header', 'recycling fileobject'). Local-rehearsal artefact, not a pipeline defect, but note the unbounded retry. The chr6:30.7-34.7 Mb LD query it was on returns 477M pairs and takes 5 min from the host: HLA leads are the expensive ones.
Kill-criterion finding: the autorep:20260608.1 image prefetches LD for every candidate lead (every p<=5e-8 variant) and by default reads the full +-2 Mb panel window per candidate. deCODE aptamers have a median 929 and up to 75,660 such variants (11.5M in total, /mnt/disks/data/decode/candidate_leads.tsv); seq.16828.8 has 9,707 and fetched <500 in 31 min wide -> days per shard. The panel is variant1-indexed, so --ld-assume-variant1-indexed (1 bp fetch, same rows, 0.6 s on the host) makes it ~1.5 s/candidate/worker: seq.16828.8 prefetch ~50 min with 4 workers. The flag existed in the image but not as a WDL input: added Boolean ld_assume_variant1_indexed to ~/autoreporting/wdl/autoreporting.wdl (uncommitted, on branch external_sumstats_only) and set it true in wdl/autoreporting_decode.json.
Result (kill criterion fired, in the fragmentation direction): seq.16828.8 (COL6A1, mlog10p 21,686) -> autoreporting 22 min with the narrow fetch, 9,707 candidates, 3,948 loci, 482 after FG filter, 471 on chr21 over >4 Mb; step 2 -> 482 sets, 320 singletons; the 2nd/3rd leads (mlog10p 3,610 / 1,148, 20-50 kb away) are variants the R12 panel does not list at r2>=0.01 with the top lead. With the proximity filter: 255 sets, 176 singletons, 244 on chr21. seq.7085.81 (CDSN): 14 min, 418 -> 59 loci -> 58 sets (27 with proximity). seq.4876.32 (F9): 7 sets. Local files under /mnt/disks/data/decode/test/. Design decision needed before submitting 4,844 shards: how to treat the LD shadow of extreme cis signals.
SURPRISED ME: the image prefetches LD for every candidate lead with a 4 Mb window by default (the narrow-fetch flag exists in the image but not in the WDL); the VM service account cannot read r13-data or finngen_commons; the cis region fragments instead of collapsing.
BROKE: the first two rehearsal attempts (expired container token -> unbounded TabixLD retry loop for 10 h; wide fetch -> days per aptamer).
DIFFERENTLY: run one strong cis aptamer through autoreporting before writing any of the configs -- everything decision-relevant came from that one run.

title: deCODE pQTL pseudo credible sets
description: Build pseudo credible sets for the deCODE 2021 plasma pQTL sumstats (gs://finngen-commons/decode/deCODE_pQTLs_NatGen2021_aligned_p0.005.tsv.gz, 4907 SomaScan aptamers, p<0.005 filtered, GRCh38, aligned to gnomAD ref/alt). Pipeline: split the combined file into per-aptamer munged sumstats -> autoreporting LD clumping (FinnGen R12 panel, ld grouping) -> wdl/create_pseudo_credible_sets.wdl. Premise: the two-step pseudo-CS pipeline works on pQTL sumstats as-is except for (a) per-trait input files, (b) no allele-frequency column, (c) dotted aptamer ids, (d) cis signals with mlog10p in the thousands. Kill criterion: a local end-to-end run on 2-3 aptamers (one strong cis, one trans) must produce pseudo credible sets whose lead matches the deCODE cis-pQTL and whose members are r2>0.6 partners; if the extreme cis signal makes autoreporting absorb the whole 4 Mb window into one set with no usable membership, stop and re-design the thresholds before running 4907 shards.
notes:
OPEN DESIGN DECISION (2026-09-21): extreme cis-pQTL signals fragment into hundreds of pseudo CS per aptamer (see cbt.3). Options on the table: (a) accept and document 'top signal only'; (b) enable step 2's proximity filter for deCODE (halves it, LD-agnostic); (c) a wider or significance-relative suppression radius, e.g. suppress any lead within +-2 Mb whose mlog10p is >N orders below the anchor; (d) keep only the strongest set per aptamer per +-2 Mb window. Not decided; full autoreporting run (4,844 shards, ~2-25 min each with the narrow fetch) not submitted. Also needed before submission: gcloud reauth on this VM (user credential), staging of the per-aptamer files and metadata, and the autoreporting WDL change (ld_assume_variant1_indexed input, uncommitted in ~/autoreporting on branch external_sumstats_only; master has the flag in main.py).
Step-1 run 2f2fafa8 (2026-09-21) post-mortem: 524/4844 shards produced a report, 110 exited 1, 4210 killed without rc. ~100 exit-1s in the first 10 min are pysam opens of gs:// files failing with EINVAL (HTTP 4xx other than auth/not-found; bogus token gives EPERM, verified in the image) = burst rate limiting from 4844 simultaneous opens of the same panel files. TabixLD retries fetches but not the open. Cromwell NoNewCalls then stopped all retries so later preemptions were fatal. Submitted WDL lacked the ld_assume_variant1_indexed input -> wide fetch, median 65 min/shard, two OOM kills at 4 GB. Rerun prepared: wdl/autoreporting_decode.rerun1.json (4320 remaining aptamers, array staged), wdl/autoreporting.cromwell_options.decode.json (ContinueWhilePossible), maxRetries: 2 on the report task in ~/autoreporting/wdl/autoreporting.wdl (uncommitted there, with the flag input). Doc: docs/pseudo-credible-sets.md 'What the first submission taught'. Pheno-info side note: phenoinfo.py int('NA') fails for every external quantitative input so report.out phenotype/category are empty; step 2 names traits from its own JSON, so harmless here (latent, not a bead).
Step 1 second run post-mortem: OOM in ld_grouping prefetch scales with candidate count (~0.9 GB/1000); tiered memory reruns prepared, see cbt.6 note and docs 'What the second submission taught'.
Step 1 done (cbt.6 closed): fofn gs://finngen-commons/results_api_metadata/autoreporting.decode.fofn, 4844 reports. Step 2 (cbt.7) is next and still needs the cis-shadow decision recorded on this epic.
DECIDED 2026-09-22 (user): (b) + (a). Step 2 for deCODE runs with the proximity filter on (drop --no-proximity-filter from wdl/create_pseudo_credible_sets.decode.json; anchors chi2>250, +-1 Mb) and the doc states that secondary sets inside a cis window are LD-panel-limited, the pseudo CS at a cis-pQTL reads as the top signal. (c)/(d) rejected: they would invent a rule the panel cannot verify.
Checked 2026-09-22 whether earlier pseudo-CS outputs in the bucket had the proximity filter: the output itself tells (a weaker lead within 1 Mb of a chi2>250 anchor of the same trait cannot survive the filter). FinnGen_R13_UKBB (2026-03-13): 520 anchors, 4851 such leads; UKBB labs (2026-03-04): 2313 anchors, 58379; EXT_20260610: 95 anchors, 725 -> all OFF, consistent with every GWAS config carrying --no-proximity-filter. No pQTL pseudo-CS existed before deCODE; the somascan/olink credible sets are SuSiE fine-mapping via munge_finngen_finemapping_results. Check script: scratchpad proxcheck.py (not in repo).
